Principle 24: The Person Whom I Respect the Most / My Dream
I have read about many interesting people in history books.
I admire and respect some of those people who appear in them.
The person I respect the most is General Soon-Shin Lee.
General Lee lived about 500 years ago,
and he defeated the Japanese in battle many times.
He lived during a difficult time of Korean history,
but he always thought of Korea and Koreans before himself.
I respect him because he was able to prepare
and carry out great triumphs over his enemies.
He always was confident that they would be successful and victorious.
I have many dreams for the future.
However, my dream job is to become an interpreter.
There are many reasons I want to become an interpreter.
First, I like learning other languages,
and learning English is very exciting for me.
Second, English is the most widely used language in the world,
so I know that English is an important to build
good international relationships.
Another reason is that I want to translate many interesting books
so that many Koreans can truly enjoy many fun and interesting books.
Furthermore, I want to interpret for people who can’t speak English,
so that they can know what is going on in the world around them.
When I grow up I want to go abroad to study English.
While studying English, I really want to work hard so that
I can accomplish my dream.
I want to learn as much English as I can
so that I can become a great interpreter.
